qs.q: Why did Turing suggest a practical test instead of defining "thinking"?
qs.qko: 튜링은 왜 «생각» 을 정의하는 대신 실제로 해 볼 수 있는 시험을 제안했나요?
opts: Because computers already understood every language
Because the judge was not allowed to use a computer
evs: Because "thinking" is hard to define, he suggested a practical test instead.
For decades, computers performed poorly at this kind of open conversation.
The debate is still open, partly because scientists do not fully understand how human thinking works either.
why: 본문에 «생각» 은 정의하기 어려워서 그 대신 실용적인 시험을 제안했다고 나와요.
The text says that because "thinking" is hard to define, he suggested a practical test instead.

qs.q: In the Turing test, what does it mean for a machine to "pass"?
qs.qko: 튜링 테스트에서 기계가 «pass(통과)» 한다는 것은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: The judge cannot reliably tell the machine from the person
The machine answers every question correctly
The machine learns Chinese with a rule book
evs: If the judge cannot reliably tell which one is the machine, the machine is said to pass.
For decades, computers performed poorly at this kind of open conversation.
By following the rules, the person can answer Chinese questions correctly without understanding a single word.
If you chat with someone online and cannot tell whether it is a person or a computer, is the computer thinking?
why: 판정하는 사람이 둘 중 어느 쪽이 기계인지 확실히 구별하지 못하면 기계가 «통과했다» 고 말해요.
If the judge cannot reliably tell which one is the machine, the machine is said to pass.

qs.q: Why does Searle think a chatbot might not really understand?
qs.qko: 설은 왜 챗봇이 정말로 이해하는 것은 아닐 수 있다고 생각하나요?
opts: Like the person in the room, it follows rules for symbols without knowing what they mean
It types too slowly to hold a real conversation
It was trained on too little text to answer questions
evs: By following the rules, the person can answer Chinese questions correctly without understanding a single word.
Searle argued that computers are like this person: they handle symbols but may not understand meaning.
Today, however, AI chatbots trained on huge amounts of text can write fluent answers on almost any topic.
Because "thinking" is hard to define, he suggested a practical test instead.
why: 방 안의 사람은 규칙만 따라서 중국어 질문에 맞게 답하지만 단어 하나도 이해하지 못해요. 설은 컴퓨터도 이 사람처럼 기호만 다룰 뿐 뜻은 이해하지 못할 수 있다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어 봐야 해요.
The person in the room answers correctly by following rules without understanding a word. Searle argued that computers are like this person: they handle symbols but may not understand meaning.
